name: agent2web
description: Self-hosted static site hosting with an MCP publishing API, for HTML built by AI tools like Claude

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs && node scripts/bundle-worker.mjs
scripts.test:worker: npm run build && node --test build/test/publish.test.js build/test/password.test.js build/test/oauth.test.js build/test/admin.test.js
